Filtering by match scores leaves the secret; guess it via the judge.
Return the hidden entry through the guessing API.

hints: Score any pair by counting equal positions; this is the value master.guess returns.
After each guess keep only candidates whose score against the guess equals the reported score.
Pick the guess minimizing the largest score-group (minimax) so the candidate pool shrinks fastest.
